newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp won't comment on Energy bid.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp won't comment on Energy bid.

text.p: PacifiCorp declined comment on an announcement earlier by Energy Group Plc about efforts by the Oregon-based utility to acquire the U.K. firm, a PacifiCorp spokesman said Tuesday.
"We have no comment on any reports related to potential transactions," said Pacificorp spokesman Dave Kvamme.
Energy Group said in a statement released from London that talks with PacifiCorp may lead to a cash takeover offer at a premium of about 20 percent to its share price.
PacifiCorp has previously said it plans to focus on global growth as the U.S. electricity sector undergoes deregulation.
Energy Group was formed in February from the spinoff of energy assets by conglomerate Hanson Plc.
The U.K. firm last month completed the acquisition of Boston-based Citizens Lehman Power, one of the top five U.S. power marketers.
Energy Group also owns Eastern Electricity, a British regional electricity supplier, and the U.S. coal business Peabody Resources Ltd.
